scenes.text: These two services can't finish starting.
scenes.phonemes: ðiːz tˈuː sˈɜːvɪsᵻz kˈænt fˈɪnɪʃ stˈɑːɹɾɪŋ.

scenes.text: Spring starts Service A, whose constructor needs Service B.
scenes.phonemes: spɹˈɪŋ stˈɑːɹts sˈɜːvɪs ˈeɪ, hˌuːz kənstɹˈʌktɚ nˈiːdz sˈɜːvɪs bˈiː.

scenes.text: But Service B needs Service A first. The arguments must exist before construction. Neither constructor can finish.
scenes.phonemes: bˌʌt sˈɜːvɪs bˈiː nˈiːdz sˈɜːvɪs ɐ fˈɜːst. ðɪ ˈɑːɹɡjuːmənts mˈʌst ɛɡzˈɪst bᵻfˌɔːɹ kənstɹˈʌkʃən. nˈiːðɚ kənstɹˈʌktɚ kæn fˈɪnɪʃ.

scenes.text: Startup fails with a bean currently in creation exception. This is a constructor cycle.
scenes.phonemes: stˈɑːɹɾʌp fˈeɪlz wɪð ɐ bˈiːn kˈɜːɹəntli ɪn kɹiːˈeɪʃən ɛksˈɛpʃən. ðɪs ɪz ɐ kənstɹˈʌktɚ sˈaɪkəl.

scenes.text: Refactor the collaboration. An orchestration service calls A and B; they no longer depend on each other.
scenes.phonemes: ɹᵻfˈæktɚ ðə kəlˌæbɚɹˈeɪʃən. ɐn ˌɔːɹkᵻstɹˈeɪʃən sˈɜːvɪs kˈɔːlz ɐ ænd bˈiː; ðeɪ nˌoʊ lˈɑːŋɡɚ dᵻpˈɛnd ˌɔn ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðɚ.

scenes.text: Our tests confirm failure before, and successful startup after. Other circular references behave differently. Redesign the dependency graph.
scenes.phonemes: ˌaʊɚ tˈɛsts kənfˈɜːm fˈeɪlɪɹ bᵻfˈɔːɹ, ænd səksˈɛsfəl stˈɑːɹɾʌp ˈæftɚ. ˈʌðɚ sˈɜːkjʊlɚ ɹˈɛfɹənsᵻz bᵻhˈeɪv dˈɪfɹəntli. ɹˌiːdɪzˈaɪn ðə dᵻpˈɛndənsi ɡɹˈæf.
